statement: The same command as results/local_python_run_2026-10-11.json, on the same box, after the cover proof measurement was fixed and verify's proof widened to three samples per span. The two tests that failed in that record pass here; the count is higher because the other session's release and report tests and this session's proof tests joined the suite in between.
command: .venv/bin/python -m pytest flashmap pipeline eval -q -m "not slow" -p no:cacheprovider

environment.load: the mutation gate's negative controls were running on the same box throughout
